result.summary: Reionization ionizing-photon-budget reconciliation at z~12: star-forming galaxies require f_esc=2.134 (+1.999/-1.053) to close the budget (Madau-Dickinson SFRD, log xi_ion=25.5+/-0.15, clumping C=2-5, JWST-SFRD tail), versus indirect-proxy-inferred f_esc=0.062 (+0.108/-0.039) from LzLCS O32/beta calibrations. Median delta(required-inferred)=+2.031 dex-frac (16-84%: +0.969 to +4.031); 100% of the systematic MC shows a shortfall. Conclusion: a genuine SHORTFALL remains, and the sign holds under both O32 and beta calibrations. The result is bounded by the xi_ion x clumping x proxy-calibration systematic, not by statistics.
result.title: A residual reionization ionizing-photon-budget shortfall for star-forming galaxies at z~12 (highC systematic corner)
result.provenance: Literature-anchored budget calculation — NO survey catalog data is used. The cosmic SFRD is the Madau & Dickinson (2014) analytic fitting function; xi_ion and the O32/beta f_esc proxy calibrations are adopted published values (LzLCS: Chisholm+22, Flury+22; Simmonds+24). Do NOT state or imply that this study uses JWST, SDSS, or TNG observational/catalog data — it is a systematics reconciliation over published literature values.
